name: Execution Isolation
description: Assessment of a directed subject/comparison boundary and explicit threats under a pinned profile. No symmetric, transitive or inherited isolation is implied. Display order grants no authority.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: Evaluation could not establish the requested claim in the stated scope.

values.label: Shared account
values.description: Compared workloads share an OS principal without additional established isolation.

values.label: Separate account
values.description: Distinct principals and relevant access controls separate the compared workloads.

values.label: Os confined
values.description: Applicable OS policy enforces the stated separation.

values.label: Virtual machine
values.description: Guest boundary separates the subject from the specified outside workloads.

values.label: Confidential workload
values.description: Applicable attestation establishes the stated protected execution boundary.
